cards.name: FIRST Millennia
cards.welcome_benefit: Rs.500 gift voucher on Rs.5,000 spend within 30 days; 5% cashback (up to Rs.1,000) on first EMI transaction within 30 days
cards.lounge_access: No airport lounge access. 4 complimentary railway lounge visits per quarter (requires Rs.20,000 spend in previous month)
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on fuel transactions of Rs.200-Rs.5,000
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, EMI transactions, cash withdrawals, fees/charges. Insurance, utilities, railways, FASTag earn only 1 RP per Rs.200 (0.5X per Rs.100)
cards.notes: Slab-based earning after Jan 18, 2026 devaluation (earn base moved Rs.150 -> Rs.200 per point): 10 RP/Rs.200 (~1.25% value) on dining, travel & international spends (Rs.20,000/month threshold for 10X removed Jun 2026); 3 RP/Rs.200 (~0.375%) on other eligible spends (modelled as base 1.5 pts/Rs.100); 1 RP/Rs.200 on insurance, utilities, railways, FASTag. From Jun-Jul 2026: points expire in 24 months (previously never-expiring), rewards accrue only on spends up to credit limit per billing cycle, travel-portal booking bonus cut to 20% (hotels)/10% (flights). Movie benefit: 25% off up to Rs.100/month on District app (needs 1 transaction in prior month). Redemption fee Rs.99+GST.

cards.name: FIRST Classic
cards.welcome_benefit: Rs.500 gift voucher on Rs.5,000 spend within 30 days; 5% cashback (up to Rs.1,000) on first EMI transaction
cards.lounge_access: No airport lounge access. 4 complimentary railway lounge visits per quarter (requires Rs.20,000 spend in previous month)
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, EMI, cash withdrawals. Insurance, utilities, railways, FASTag, UPI up to Rs.2,000 earn only 1 RP per Rs.200
cards.notes: Same post-Jan-2026 structure as Millennia: 10 RP/Rs.200 on dining, travel & international; 3 RP/Rs.200 other spends; 1 RP/Rs.200 on insurance/utilities/railways/FASTag/UPI up to Rs.2,000. Points valid 24 months; rewards only up to credit limit per cycle (Jun 2026). Movie: 25% off up to Rs.100/month on District. Redemption fee Rs.99+GST. Effectively a twin of Millennia; Classic is the older/branch-sourced variant.

cards.name: FIRST Select
cards.welcome_benefit: Rs.500 voucher on Rs.5,000 spend within 30 days; 5% cashback (up to Rs.1,000) on first EMI
cards.lounge_access: 1 domestic airport lounge visit per quarter + 4 railway lounge visits per quarter (both require Rs.20,000 spend in previous month). No international lounge
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on fuel transactions of Rs.200-Rs.5,000
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, EMI, cash withdrawals. Insurance, utilities, railways, FASTag earn 1 RP per Rs.200
cards.notes: Post-Jan-2026 structure: 10 RP/Rs.200 on dining, travel & international; 3 RP/Rs.200 on other spends; 1 RP/Rs.200 reduced categories. Points valid 24 months; rewards only up to credit limit per cycle. Movie: buy-1-get-1 up to Rs.125 on District (needs Rs.20,000 prior-month spend). Redemption fee Rs.99+GST.

cards.name: FIRST Wealth
cards.welcome_benefit: Rs.500 voucher (Amazon/Uber/BigBasket) on Rs.5,000 spend within 30 days; 5% cashback up to Rs.1,000 on first EMI
cards.lounge_access: 1 domestic + 1 international airport lounge visit per quarter and 4 railway lounge visits per quarter (airport visits require Rs.20,000 spend in previous month)
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver up to Rs.300/month on fuel transactions of Rs.200-Rs.5,000
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, EMI, cash withdrawals. Insurance, utilities, railways, FASTag and UPI up to Rs.2,000 earn 1 RP per Rs.200
cards.notes: Post-Jan-2026 structure: 10 RP/Rs.200 (~1.25%) on dining, travel & international — Jun 18, 2026 change removed the earlier Rs.20,000/month spend precondition for 10X; 3 RP/Rs.200 on other spends and on UPI above Rs.2,000; 1 RP/Rs.200 on reduced categories and UPI up to Rs.2,000. Jun 2026 devaluation: lifetime point validity replaced by 24 months; rewards only up to credit limit per cycle; movie BOGO (up to Rs.250, twice/month on District) now needs Rs.20,000 prior-month spend. Golf: 1 complimentary round/lesson per month on Rs.20,000 prior-month spend. Redemption fee Rs.99+GST.

cards.name: FIRST WOW!
cards.lounge_access: None (no domestic/international airport lounge)
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, EMI, cash withdrawals. Utilities and insurance earn 1 RP per Rs.200
cards.eligibility: Age 18+, resident Indian; secured against fixed deposit of Rs.20,000+; no income proof or credit history needed. Credit limit = 100% of FD
cards.notes: Flat 4 RP per Rs.200 (~0.5% value) on online and offline spends; 1 RP/Rs.200 on utilities/insurance. Zero forex markup is the headline feature. Jun 2026 changes: points now valid 24 months; rewards only up to credit limit per cycle. Movie discounts via District app. Redemption fee Rs.99+GST.

cards.name: FIRST WOW! Black
cards.welcome_benefit: Assured welcome benefits worth Rs.5,000+ (flight/hotel discounts, dining memberships, EMI cashback)
cards.lounge_access: 1 domestic airport lounge visit per quarter (requires Rs.20,000 spend in previous month)
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, EMI, cash withdrawals. Insurance/utilities earn 1 RP per Rs.150; UPI earns up to 3 RP per Rs.150
cards.eligibility: Age 18+, resident Indian; secured against FD of Rs.20,000+
cards.notes: 4 RP per Rs.150 (~0.67% value) on online/offline spends; points worth Rs.0.50 each on travel bookings via IDFC portal (Rs.0.25 elsewhere). Bonus travel-portal earnings capped at 8,000 RP/month (modelled in bonus_monthly_cap). Zero forex markup. Trip cancellation cover up to Rs.10,000/year.

cards.name: FIRST EARN
cards.welcome_benefit: 10% cashback up to Rs.250 on first transaction within 15 days (joining fee waived as limited-period offer)
cards.lounge_access: None
cards.reward_exclusions: EMI and cash transactions earn nothing
cards.eligibility: Secured against FD of Rs.5,000+; credit limit 100%-2x of FD; no income proof
cards.notes: UPI-first digital RuPay card: 1% cashback on UPI spends via IDFC FIRST app, 0.5% on other eligible spends (incl. utilities, wallets, insurance, UPI on other apps). Total cashback capped at Rs.500 per statement cycle (modelled in base_monthly_cap, applies across base+bonus). Physical card available for Rs.199. Travel portal: 8% back on hotels, 4% on flights.

cards.name: Hello Cashback
cards.welcome_benefit: Joining fee currently waived (limited-period offer)
cards.lounge_access: None
cards.fuel_surcharge_waiver: 1% waiver on fuel transactions of Rs.200-Rs.5,000, capped at Rs.100/cycle
cards.reward_exclusions: Usual exclusions (fuel, EMI, cash); no movie/dining/travel benefits
cards.eligibility: Secured card against FD of Rs.10,000+; credit limit = 100% of FD; aimed at first-time cardholders
cards.notes: Launched 2026. 5% cashback on online spends when online spends in the cycle reach Rs.10,000 (3% below that), 1% on other spends and UPI. Online cashback capped at Rs.1,000/cycle (bonus_monthly_cap); total cashback capped at Rs.1,500/cycle (base_monthly_cap models total cap). Cashback auto-adjusts against statement, no redemption fee.

cards.name: FIRST Power (HPCL)
cards.welcome_benefit: Rs.250 fuel gift voucher on first HPCL fuel transaction above Rs.250
cards.lounge_access: None (roadside assistance worth Rs.1,399 instead)
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel beyond monthly caps, EMI, cash withdrawals
cards.notes: HPCL co-brand. 15 RP per Rs.150 (~2.5% value) on HPCL fuel (marketed 'up to 5% savings' incl. surcharge waiver and HP Pay app extras; fuel rewards capped around Rs.5,000 fuel spend/month), 15 RP/Rs.150 on grocery & utilities (cap ~Rs.4,000 spend/month), 2.5% on IDFC FASTag (cap ~Rs.2,000/month), 2 RP/Rs.150 on other retail (base). A RuPay/UPI variant was introduced in 2026. Jun 2026: points valid 24 months; rewards only up to credit limit. Cap figures are as reported by aggregators — verify against MITC before relying on them.

cards.name: FIRST Power+ (HPCL)
cards.welcome_benefit: Rs.500 gift voucher on first HPCL transaction of Rs.500+; 5% cashback on first EMI (up to Rs.1,000)
cards.lounge_access: 1 domestic airport lounge visit per quarter (requires Rs.20,000 spend in previous month); roadside assistance worth Rs.1,399
cards.reward_exclusions: HPCL fuel/LPG beyond monthly point caps, EMI, cash withdrawals
cards.notes: HPCL co-brand, higher tier. 30 RP per Rs.150 (~5% value) on HPCL fuel & LPG, capped at 2,400 RP/cycle (bonus_monthly_cap); ~5% on grocery & utilities (cap reported ~Rs.2,000 value/month); 30 RP/Rs.150 on IDFC FASTag (cap ~Rs.1,000/month); 3 RP/Rs.150 on other retail (base, uncapped). Some aggregators quote 24X vs 30X on fuel post-devaluations — treat category caps as approximate and verify with MITC. Jun 2026: points valid 24 months; rewards only up to credit limit.

cards.name: Club Vistara IDFC FIRST
cards.welcome_benefit: Historically: 1 Premium Economy ticket voucher, class upgrade voucher, Maharaja Club (ex-CV) Silver tier — welcome/renewal/milestone benefits withdrawn from Apr 1, 2025
cards.milestone_benefits: Removed effective April 2025 (milestone ticket vouchers no longer apply)
cards.lounge_access: 2 domestic lounge/spa visits per quarter + 1 international lounge visit per quarter (requires Rs.5,000 min monthly spend)
cards.reward_exclusions: Utilities, fuel, rent, insurance earn only 1 point per Rs.200
cards.notes: DISCONTINUED after the Vistara-Air India merger (Nov 2024). No new issuance; existing cards remain active until 30 Sep 2026, earning spend-based Maharaja Points only, then will be closed. No annual fee levied and no annual/milestone benefits during the wind-down. Earn: 6 Maharaja Points per Rs.200 up to Rs.1 lakh/cycle, 4 per Rs.200 beyond (base modelled as 6/200 = 3 per Rs.100); rupee_per_point null because Maharaja Points redeem dynamically on Air India.

cards.name: Ashva
cards.welcome_benefit: Up to 7,500 RP: 2,500 on joining-fee payment + 2,500 each on Rs.20,000+ spend in 2nd and 3rd statement cycles
cards.milestone_benefits: 7,500 RP (worth ~Rs.1,875) on Rs.8 lakh annual spend
cards.lounge_access: 4 domestic + 2 international airport lounge visits per quarter and 4 railway lounge visits per quarter (airport access requires Rs.20,000 prior-month spend)
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, EMI conversions, fees, loan-on-card, balance transfers, cash withdrawals. Rent, wallet load, education, government earn 3X/Rs.150; insurance and utilities earn 1X/Rs.150
cards.notes: Slab-based on Rs.150 earn base: 5X (5 RP/Rs.150 = 3.33/Rs.100, base slab) up to Rs.20,000 per cycle, 10X (6.67/Rs.100) on incremental spends above Rs.20,000. Travel portal redemption ~Rs.0.40/point (Rs.0.25 standard) plus booking bonus points (10% hotels, 5% flights) capped 15,000 bonus RP/month. Movie BOGO up to Rs.400 twice/month on District (from Jun 2026 requires Rs.20,000 prior-month spend). Golf: 2 rounds/lessons per month on Rs.20,000+ spend. Cancel-for-any-reason travel cover up to Rs.25,000 twice/year. No spend-based fee waiver reported.

cards.name: Mayura
cards.welcome_benefit: 12,000 RP total: 4,000 on joining-fee payment + 4,000 each across two subsequent statement cycles
cards.milestone_benefits: 7,500 RP on Rs.8 lakh and 15,000 RP on Rs.15 lakh annual spend
cards.lounge_access: 16 domestic (incl. 1 guest visit/quarter) + 16 international airport lounge visits per year and 16 railway lounge visits per year (requires Rs.20,000 prior-month spend)
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, EMI conversions, fees, loan-on-card, balance transfers, cash withdrawals. Rent/education 3X and insurance/utilities 1X per Rs.150
cards.notes: Slab-based on Rs.150 earn base: 5X up to Rs.20,000/cycle (base), 10X on incremental spends above Rs.20,000. Point worth Rs.0.50 on travel bookings via IDFC portal, Rs.0.25 elsewhere; travel-portal bonus earn capped 25,000 RP/month; annual redemption cap 300,000 points. Zero forex markup. Golf 2 rounds/month; movie BOGO up to Rs.500 twice/month on District (Rs.20,000 prior-month spend required from Jun 2026). Network not confirmed on sources used (likely Visa Infinite) — left null.

cards.name: Diamond Reserve
cards.welcome_benefit: Rs.500 gift voucher (Amazon/BigBasket/Uber/Lifestyle) on Rs.5,000 spend within 30 days
cards.lounge_access: 2 domestic + 2 international airport lounge visits per quarter and 4 railway lounge visits per quarter (requires Rs.20,000 monthly spend; shared with add-on)
cards.reward_exclusions: International spends earn NO reward points (despite zero forex), plus fuel, EMI conversions, fees/GST, loan-on-card, balance transfers, cash withdrawals, transactions below Rs.150
cards.eligibility: Also offered fee-waived to invite-only Diamond Reserve savings account holders
cards.notes: Launched 2025-26 alongside the Diamond Reserve savings program. Slab-based on Rs.150 base: 3 RP/Rs.150 (2/Rs.100) up to Rs.20,000 per cycle, 10 RP/Rs.150 (6.67/Rs.100) above. Zero forex markup but international spends earn no points. Movie BOGO up to Rs.250 twice/month on District (Rs.20,000 prior-month spend needed from Jun 2026); golf 2 rounds/month on Rs.40,000 spend. Annual fee waived on Rs.6 lakh spend. Redemption fee Rs.99+GST.

cards.name: Gaj
cards.welcome_benefit: 12,500 RP + 25% off (up to Rs.75,000) on 5-star hotel bookings on Rs.1,00,000 spend within 60 days
cards.lounge_access: 4 domestic (incl. 1 guest) + 4 international airport lounge visits per quarter; 4 railway lounge visits per quarter (railway requires Rs.20,000 monthly spend)
cards.reward_exclusions: Select categories earn only 1 RP/Rs.150; usual exclusions (fuel, EMI, cash)
cards.notes: Invite-only metal card launched 2026. Earn on Rs.150 base: 5 RP/Rs.150 (3.33/Rs.100) domestic, 3 RP/Rs.150 (2/Rs.100) international, 1 RP/Rs.150 select categories. Points worth Rs.1 each on hotel/flight bookings via IDFC Travel portal (up to 4x uplift vs Rs.0.25 voucher value; rupee_per_point kept at 0.25 conservative); travel-portal booking bonuses (45 RP/Rs.150 hotels, 20 RP/Rs.150 flights) capped 15,000 bonus RP/month; redemption capped Rs.1.5 lakh/month and Rs.3 lakh/year. Golf up to 24 rounds/year (spend-based). Zero forex. Jun 2026: rewards only up to credit limit per cycle.

cards.name: FIRST Private
cards.welcome_benefit: 50,000 RP + complimentary Club ITC Culinaire membership
cards.milestone_benefits: Taj Experiences Signature Dining voucher on Rs.15 lakh cumulative spend within 6 months
cards.lounge_access: Unlimited domestic and international airport lounge access for primary and add-on cardholders (+4 guest visits/year); unlimited railway lounge access
cards.reward_exclusions: Rent/education earn 3X and insurance 1X per Rs.150; usual exclusions apply
cards.eligibility: Invite-only (typically IDFC FIRST Private banking clients)
cards.notes: Flagship invite-only card. 10 RP per Rs.150 (6.67/Rs.100) on eligible spends; points worth Rs.1 each on IDFC Travel & Shop portal (i.e. up to ~6.67% value back; rupee_per_point kept at conservative Rs.0.25 voucher value — use Rs.1 if user redeems via portal), 3X on rent/education, 1X insurance. Unlimited golf rounds/lessons + 1 international golf round/quarter. Zero forex, no late payment charges, 0.75%/month interest. Fee effectively not waivable (relationship-based).

cards.name: FIRST SWYP
cards.welcome_benefit: 1,000 RP on first EMI transaction; Rs.500 Amazon voucher on Rs.5,000 spend in 30 days; EaseMyTrip coupons worth Rs.2,100; 1-year Lenskart Gold Max membership; renewal bonus 2,000 RP on Rs.5,000 spend within 45 days
cards.milestone_benefits: Monthly spend tiers ARE the reward program (see notes)
cards.lounge_access: 4 railway lounge visits per quarter; no airport lounge by default (domestic lounge unlockable via 10 referrals)
cards.reward_exclusions: Cash withdrawals, utility payments and fuel do not count toward monthly spend tiers
cards.notes: EMI-focused Gen-Z card with NON-LINEAR slab earning — base_points_per_100 left null because points are awarded per monthly spend tier, not per transaction: Rs.5,000+ = 200 RP; Rs.10,000+ = 500 RP; Rs.15,000+ = 1,000 RP; Rs.30,000+ = 2,000 RP; Rs.60,000+ = 4,000 RP (max/month, ~1.67% value at exact tier boundaries; nothing extra between tiers). +100 RP on Rs.5,000 UPI spends (UPI feature costs Rs.199+GST/year). Any-spend-to-EMI conversion with flat fee from Rs.49/month instead of interest. Annual fee waived via 1 successful referral (not spend-based). Redemption fee Rs.99+GST.

cards.name: FIRST Digital RuPay
cards.welcome_benefit: 100% cashback of Rs.200 total (up to Rs.50 each) on first 4 UPI transactions within 15 days
cards.lounge_access: None
cards.reward_exclusions: Standard IDFC exclusions (fuel, EMI, cash)
cards.eligibility: Issued alongside/against an existing IDFC FIRST credit card; links to BHIM/GPay/PhonePe/Paytm for UPI
cards.notes: Virtual RuPay card mainly for UPI on credit: 3 RP per Rs.150 on UPI spends above Rs.2,000, 1 RP per Rs.150 on UPI spends up to Rs.2,000 (base). Often taken as a companion to a primary IDFC Visa/Mastercard card.

cards.name: LIC Classic

merchant_bonuses.merchant: LIC insurance premium (via LIC official website)

cards.welcome_benefit: Joining vouchers/points offers run periodically (e.g. Rs.2,500 welcome offers per bank PDF)
cards.lounge_access: Up to 8 domestic airport lounge visits per year (requires Rs.20,000 prior-month spend) + 4 railway lounge visits per quarter
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, rental, non-LIC insurance, EMI, cash withdrawals. LIC premium points only when paid via LIC of India official website
cards.notes: LIC Cards + IDFC FIRST co-brand, lifetime free. Earn base Rs.125: 6X (6 RP/Rs.125 = 4.8/Rs.100) on LIC insurance premiums, 3X (2.4/Rs.100) on groceries, utilities, railways, FASTag, education, government and other spends. Points valid 3 years. Personal accident cover Rs.2 lakh; roadside assistance worth Rs.1,399. Redemption fee Rs.99+GST.

cards.name: LIC Select

merchant_bonuses.merchant: LIC insurance premium (via LIC official website)

cards.welcome_benefit: 2,000 RP on Rs.10,000 spend within 30 days; 1-year Lenskart Gold membership; 6-month PharmEasy Plus membership
cards.lounge_access: 2 domestic airport lounge visits per quarter (requires Rs.5,000 prior-month spend) + 4 railway lounge visits per quarter
cards.reward_exclusions: Fuel, rental, non-LIC insurance, EMI, cash withdrawals. LIC premium points only via LIC official website
cards.eligibility: Higher tier of the LIC co-brand pair
cards.notes: Lifetime free. Earn base Rs.125: 10X (10 RP/Rs.125 = 8/Rs.100) on LIC insurance premiums, 5X (4/Rs.100) on groceries, utilities, education, railways, government AND other spends — the 5X on the essential categories is capped at 300 points/month (bonus_monthly_cap). Points valid 3 years. Redemption fee Rs.99.

cards.name: IndiGo IDFC FIRST
cards.variant: Dual card (Mastercard + RuPay, shared limit); secured FD option
cards.welcome_benefit: 5,000 BluChips voucher + meal voucher + 3-month EazyDiner membership + Rs.3,000 hotel voucher; extra 3,000 BluChips on Rs.1 lakh spend within 90 days (welcome benefits not offered on the FD-secured variant)
cards.milestone_benefits: Up to 25,000 additional BluChips at Rs.2L/5L/8L/10L/12L annual spend milestones
cards.lounge_access: None
cards.reward_exclusions: No BluChips on EMI conversions. From Jul 2026: UPI, insurance, rent, utilities, wallet, FASTag, railway, government, education earn only 0.5 BluChips/Rs.100, and BluChips require minimum payment by due date
cards.eligibility: Regular unsecured issuance, or secured against Rs.1 lakh+ FD (first-year fee waived on secured route)
cards.notes: Airline co-brand launched 2025-26. Up to 22 BluChips/Rs.100 on IndiGo bookings (tiered), 3 BluChips/Rs.100 on other spends (base), 0.5 on reduced categories. BluChip value is dynamic (~Rs.0.40-0.50 when redeemed on IndiGo) so rupee_per_point is null — assume ~0.45 for comparisons. Jul 2026 changes: rewards capped at credit limit per cycle; minimum-due payment required for BluChips accrual.

cards.name: Business Max
cards.notes: Business card launched 2026, lifetime free, low-APR positioning. Up to 6 RP on mandatory business payments (GST, taxes) and up to 3 RP on eligible UPI vendor transactions (earn base per Rs.200; exact per-Rs.100 rate not fully verified, hence base null). Points valid 24 months. Verify MITC before import.

cards.name: Business Multiplier
cards.variant: Metal; available against FD from Rs.50,000
cards.lounge_access: Complimentary domestic and international lounge visits (spend-based conditions)
cards.eligibility: Founders/entrepreneurs; unsecured or against FD from Rs.50,000
cards.notes: Business metal card launched May 2026. 10 RP per Rs.200 (5/Rs.100, ~1.25% value) on retail + UPI up to Rs.1 lakh per billing cycle, then 5 RP per Rs.200 (2.5/Rs.100) beyond; up to 10 RP on online GST/tax payments. Zero forex markup. Up to 5 add-on cards at Rs.250 each. Annual fee reversed on Rs.5 lakh annual spend.

cards.name: FIRST Business
cards.notes: SME business card (UPI-enabled, rewards, 1.99% forex per bank site). Detailed fee/reward terms not verified from the sources used — treat as placeholder pending MITC check. IDFC also offers FIRST Corporate, FIRST Purchase and Micro Enterprise commercial cards, excluded from this consumer catalog.
